items.name: adwaita-theme
items.title: Adwaita theme
items.description: The variables every component here reads: libadwaita's radii, easing, opacities and colours. Install this first.

items.name: button
items.title: Button
items.description: Adwaita's button: 9px radius, 24px content height, 5px by 10px padding, and a focus ring which animates inward.

items.name: card
items.title: Card
items.description: The card style class: a 12px radius and a focus ring at offset zero.

items.name: boxed-list
items.title: Boxed list
items.description: Adw.PreferencesGroup's list and Adw.ActionRow: rows in one 12px card, 8px on the end rows' own corners.
